name: Tasty Chef
summary: 餐厅经营与烹饪模拟，2026 年 9 月 23 日上市，Xpercent Games 开发并发行。开发者写明开发期用生成式 AI 制作了游戏内全部视觉美术素材与音乐，产出由开发者审阅、挑选并整合，同时声明游玩过程中不生成 AI 内容。八个领域登记美术、音乐两处已使用与游玩时生成一处自述未使用，代码、配音、文本、翻译与营销本次披露未说明。

aiAreaNotes.art: 开发者写明生成式 AI 在游戏开发期被用来制作“all visual art assets”（全部视觉美术素材），并说明产出由开发者审阅、挑选与整合。本领域登记为已使用，覆盖范围由开发者自己写成“全部”。
aiAreaNotes.music: 同一句把“music”（音乐）与视觉美术并列，声明都由生成式 AI 制作；没有说明曲目数量或是否有人工改写。
aiAreaNotes.ingame: 披露最后一句写明 The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.，这是对运行时生成的“未使用”自述，未经独立核实。

sources.label: Props for disclosing AI, but why?
sources.excerpt:
Why publish a game with AI designed into the core aspects of your game? It absolutely kills all motivation to even give it a try.
Alarris View Profile View Posts Oct 19 @ 1:32pm Report this post Disclosing it helps prevent all the outrage people would have if they found out after buying it. It's actually a smart move in this case. Those that don't care if AI was used will buy it, and enjoy it. And given the good reviews, it looks like they have. #1
Avem View Profile View Posts 1 Oct 19 @ 3:13pm Report this post Originally posted by Alarris : Disclosing it helps prevent all the outrage people would have if they found out after buying it. It's actually a smart move in this case. Those that don't care if AI was used will buy it, and enjoy it. And given the good reviews, it looks like they have. I mean, when every object in the game is AI, it becomes something that doesn't spark enjoyment. #2
Hamrath View Profile View Posts Oct 20 @ 9:32am Report this post Originally posted by Avem : [...] I mean, when every object in the game is AI, it becomes something that doesn't spark enjoyment. And yet the game made at least 200k and has 92% positive reviews... You see the irony, right? #3
Avem View Profile View Posts 1 Oct 20 @ 11:23am Report this post Originally posted by Hamrath : Originally posted by Avem : [...] I mean, when every object in the game is AI, it becomes something that doesn't spark enjoyment. And yet the game made at least 200k and has 92% positive reviews... You see the irony, right? 200k sales is assuming the number they have is all pure or if some people received a free copy and isn't reviewing. All in all, this isn't "you see the irony," and more of a lot of people don't understand the use of AI. #4
Hamrath View Profile View Posts 1 Oct 20 @ 1:31pm Report this post Sorry, my bad. They didn't sell or gave away 200k units, The game has sold an estimated 25,000 copies and $200k gross revenue. The game is even based on a tutorial, so it's not unique at all. That's were I got the numbers from, as I get the newsletter from the tutor (which is known as CodeMonkey, you can find him on Youtube). People don't care about the use of AI as long as the game is fun. I'm almost 100% sure that nobody bought the game, because it advertises its usage of AI. They bought it, because it looks cute and plays fine. If you don't like the use of AI, that's okay. But AI generated games will get better and sooner or late the terrible slop (e.g. the Vampire Survivor or Supermarket Simulator clones) will vanish. This one stays as an example how to use AI successfully. #5
mcnichoj View Profile View Posts Oct 21 @ 11:39am Report this post Originally posted by Avem : Originally posted by Hamrath : And yet the game made at least 200k and has 92% positive reviews... You see the irony, right? 200k sales is assuming the number they have is all pure or if some people received a free copy and isn't reviewing. All in all, this isn't "you see the irony," and more of a lot of people don't understand the use of AI. You can only generate 100 keys at a time and then you have to wait a while to generate more IIRC and most people that get review copies usually don't bother to even play the game, let alone review it. #6
Shataka View Profile View Posts Nov 1 @ 6:28pm Report this post Except that's a load of poo. No one cares about AI when it's not blatantly low effort trash. People who think AI = slop don't think critically. Slop just means low effort. It takes a lot of work and care to do a game like this. #7

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商均为 Xpercent Games）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 80），首页有 1 个命中 AI 关键词的主题“Props for disclosing AI, but why?”，已读取全帖：发帖人认为把 AI 做进游戏核心反而劝退，回帖者认为公开披露反而避免了买后翻车，随后几楼转入对销量与营收的估算（有人写“至少 20 万”，下一楼自称更正为约 2.5 万份与 20 万美元流水），还有人断言本作基于一位 YouTube 教程作者的模板。这些都出自玩家与第三方估算，帖内没有带开发方身份的回复，本站不采信其中任何数字，只登记讨论本身，不改变领域结论。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源：AI Transparency Index 本作条目把披露概括为“生成式 AI 用于制作全部视觉美术与音乐”，页面自述分类由模型给出、其置信度不是人工复核分；GameDB.ai 本作条目自述其 AI 标签读自各游戏的 Steam 披露，把本作标为 Art(Core) 与 Music & SFX(Core)，属转录。其余 3 条为本作商店页与折扣入口（含同一商店页的两种 snr 参数）与一个 YouTube Shorts 视频条目。检索结果为空只说明本次检索范围，不能据此证明没有 AI。八个领域全部按商店披露原文判定，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI was used during development to create all visual art assets and music featured in the game. The generated content was reviewed, selected, and integrated by the developer. The game does not generate AI content during gameplay.

english.summary: A cozy restaurant management and cooking game released on Sep 23, 2026, developed and published by Xpercent Games. The developer states that generative AI was used during development to create all visual art assets and the music in the game, that the generated output was reviewed, selected and integrated by the developer, and that the game does not generate AI content during gameplay. Art and music are recorded as used and run-time generation as a self-reported none, while code, voice, writing, translation and marketing are recorded as not addressed.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer and publisher both Xpercent Games) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 80), where one topic matches the AI keyword set, titled Props for disclosing AI, but why. It was opened and read in full: the opening post argues that putting AI at the core of the game kills the motivation to try it, a reply calls the disclosure a smart move that avoids outrage after purchase, and later posts turn into estimates of sales and revenue, one claiming at least 200k and the next correcting it to about 25,000 copies and 200k US dollars gross, with another asserting the game is based on a YouTube tutorial template. All of that comes from players and third-party guesswork, nobody in the thread writes with a developer identity, so none of those figures is adopted here and the thread is logged without changing any area finding. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 2 raw sources were read: an AI Transparency Index entry summarising the disclosure as generative AI creating all visual art and music, which states on the page that its classification is model-produced and its confidence figure is not a human review score, and a GameDB.ai entry that says its AI labels are read from each game Steam disclosure and tags this game Art and Music and SFX, i.e. a transcription. The other results were the store page and its discount entry and one YouTube Shorts item. An empty press finding only describes this search scope and is not evidence that no AI was used. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text and rests on the developer own statement, without an independent audit.

aiAreaNotes.art: The developer states that generative AI was used during development to create all visual art assets in the game, with the generated content reviewed, selected and integrated by the developer. The scope of all is the developer own wording, not a count this site could verify.
aiAreaNotes.ingame: The disclosure closes with the sentence stating that the game does not generate AI content during gameplay; this is a self-report of non-use at run time and was not independently verified.
aiAreaNotes.music: The same sentence that covers the visual art also names the music featured in the game as generative-AI produced, without saying how many tracks or whether any were later rewritten.
